files.description: Repository-wide PRKS engineering, safety, testing, storage, and issue-tracking rules.
PRKS security boundaries, deployment assumptions, sensitive-data constraints, and vulnerability scope.
Backend persistence, privacy-safe logging, filesystem, backup/restore, database, indexing, durability, and cross-domain invariants.
Frontend runtime, workspace, TabContext, navigation, offline/PWA, interaction, and cross-boundary behavior invariants.
Vue 3 + TypeScript source, migration ownership boundaries, typed API/state guidance, and routing to shared frontend/offline contracts.
Authoritative PRKS visual and interaction design contract for user-visible frontend changes.
Test-layer routing, storage safety, and rules for loading the production-domain invariants exercised by a test.
Browser E2E isolation, synchronization, tiering, performance, and debugging policy.

Approved-in-direction Work/Manifestation/Asset domain design. Treat SQLite/local-storage mechanics as current migration details; #310/#311 own the long-term PostgreSQL, Library/account, configurable-data-root, and storage-backend target.
